title: The Altitude Where Past-Tense Still Grows

features.name: impossible-tree
features.desc-on-touch: A tree that fell decades ago and never stopped falling. It grows upward and downward at once. At this altitude, time folded.

features.name: ancient-cairn
features.desc-on-touch: A marker left by someone who knew time wouldn't stop here. The stones still hum with the voice of whoever placed them.

features.name: ghost-breath
features.desc-on-touch: Something that shouldn't be here but is. It moves, but you can't say in which direction. Time means nothing at this height.

inscription: at this altitude, tenses lose meaning; what fell is still falling; what grew still grows

reverie.title: REVERIE — the altitude where nothing finished
narr: At this height the wind remembers colder versions
of itself. She pointed: that tree still grows.
It fell in 1987. The archive doesn't forget things.
It makes them coexist. Past isn't over. It's just
becoming something else up here. You could feel
